sentences.text:
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant submitted that while passing the award dated 6th July, 2024 (hereinafter "impugned award") the learned Tribunal failed to consider the relevant facts of the case as well as the law and there are several discrepancies in the same.
3.
It is submitted that the learned Tribunal also ignored the fact that the deceased was a married person and his wife was not impleaded as a party in the proceedings before the learned Tribunal.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant further submitted that learned Tribunal also failed to appreciate the evidence and the documents on record.
5. Therefore, in view of the above facts and circumstances and the foregoing submissions, it is prayed that the impugned award may be set aside.
6. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant undertakes to deposit the entire compensation amount as per the impugned award passed by the learned Tribunal.

7. Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant.
8.
Issue notice of the appeal and the accompanying application to respondents through all permissible modes on filing PF within one week.
9. This Court is, prima facie, satisfied that the matter requires consideration.

Since the matter requires consideration, this Court is inclined to grant the stay on the operation of the impugned award.
10.
Accordingly, subject to the appellant depositing the entire This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/09/2024 at 00:02:44 compensation amount along with the interest from the date of the institution of the claim in terms of the impugned award before the Registrar General of this Court within a period of six weeks, the operation of the impugned award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The amount so deposited by the appellant shall be invested in an interest bearing FDR in an auto renewal mode.
11. List on 13th November, 2024 before the Joint Registrar (Judicial) for completion of service and pleadings.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J SEPTEMBER 11, 2024 gs/sm
